allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation regarding receipt of Trading Approval from NSE and BSE for trading of 28,21,411Equity Shares allotted pursuant to conversion of Share Warrants issued on preferential basis.'.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation for receipt of listing approval from National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and Bombay StockExchange Limited (BSE) for listing of 28,21,411 Equity Shares allotted on July 10, 2026 pursuant to conversion of ShareWarrants issued and allotted to promoter and non-promoter category of persons on preferential basis.'.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Receipt of the Trading approval from National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange Limited (BSE) for Trading of 19,27,611 Equity Shares allotted to non-promoter category of persons on a preferential basis'.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Receipt of listing approval from National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange Limited (BSE) for listing of 1927611 Equity Shares allotted to non-promoter category of persons on preferential basis'.

allot.subject: Book Closure
allot.text: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited has informed the Exchange that Register of Members & Share Transfer Books of the Company will remain closed from 27-Dec-2024 to 02-Jan-2025 for the purpose of Preferential Offer.

allot.subject: Record Date
allot.text: South West Pinnacle Exploration Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Preferential Offer  is 26-Dec-2024.
